lines.en: Water passes my gills as I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我在这片海里已经很老了
lines.en: I'm old in this sea.

lines.zh: 鳞片上的光，是海晶石的色
lines.en: The light on my scales is prismarine's color.
Not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 经过神殿的柱子，我绕一圈
lines.en: I circle the temple pillar as I pass.
One flick of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 身体比守卫者更长，你看着吧
lines.en: My body is longer than a guardian's, watch.
I swim along a whole bed of kelp.

lines.zh: 这片水域的深浅，我都记得
lines.en: I remember every depth of these waters.
Water pressure does nothing to me.
I slow by the reef and look around.

lines.zh: 游过去的时候，鱼群都散开
lines.en: The fish scatter as I pass.

lines.zh: 身上的晶片碰着水，会响
lines.en: The crystals on me ring through the water.
I follow the trench along the seabed.

lines.zh: 能见度不高，我照样认路
lines.en: Visibility is poor; I still know the way.
Swim slowly; this sea is in no hurry.
I hover on the bottom, waiting.
Light falls through the water onto my back.

lines.zh: 气泡一个接一个浮上去
lines.en: Bubbles rise one after another.
This one is too old to bother moving.
There are fine scratches on my shell.
This stretch is too quiet.
My crystals are still growing.

lines.zh: 水流在变，我知道要来了
lines.en: The current shifts; I know what's coming.
I turn my body slightly.
Old bones don't want to chase.

lines.zh: 神殿的影子落在我身上
lines.en: The temple's shadow falls across me.
I'm counting the cracks on the seabed.
My crystals brighten, then dim.
I've watched this place a long time.
You came down, and you carry iron.

lines.zh: 水里的光，把你的影子拉长
lines.en: The water's light stretches your shadow.
I'm older than you imagine.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我鳞上有刺
lines.en: Don't come so close; my scales have spines.
How long can you hold your breath?
I look down from above the temple.

lines.zh: 你的动作在水里太慢了
lines.en: Your movements are too slow in water.
I keep watch over these waters.
That lantern of yours stands out.
I've lived long, and watched longer.
A few scales came off; it's fine.
That hit my flank.

lines.zh: 我退了一段，水被我搅浑
lines.en: I drew back and muddied the water.
I'm old; I mend slowly.
Not deep, but not shallow.
One crystal cracked.
I bear it and sink deeper.
You struck by my gills.
I can bear this much.
My swimming has slowed a little.
I need no feeding in water.
The thing in your hand has gone soft.
I've eaten too much kelp.
Bait does nothing to an old guardian.
Drop it and let it sink.
I looked and didn't move.

lines.zh: 这点分量，不值得游过去
lines.en: Not worth swimming over for.
I'm not hungry, only old.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高点，我看不清
lines.en: Raise the lantern, I can't see.

lines.zh: 喂我的东西要留在水里
lines.en: What feeds me should stay in the water.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，水里会荡开一圈
lines.en: You hit me and a ring ripples out.
My scales are harder than your plate.

lines.zh: 水流推着你过来，我挡住
lines.en: The current pushed you at me; I blocked it.
Don't press against my gills.
I turn and my tail sweeps past you.
Back off, this body isn't for leaning on.
Your foot kicked my fin.

lines.zh: 水把我推得慢，撞着也不重
lines.en: Water slows me, so the hit isn't heavy.
One bump and you drift away.
Move, I'm going through this gate.
I'm too old for that.
Guardians don't pair; they keep doors.

lines.zh: 这片神殿里只有我一个
lines.en: I'm alone in this temple.
My kind are in other waters, far off.

lines.zh: 我生了晶片，那算不算后代
lines.en: I grow crystals; do they count as offspring?
The current carries everything away.

lines.zh: 这个话题，我没什么可说
lines.en: I have nothing to say on that.
You ask like a child.

lines.zh: 我活了这么久，见过太多
lines.en: I've lived long and seen too much.
Ask again when I sink.
This prismarine, I know it.
What sinks, I pick up.
My fin has a hard time holding it.

lines.zh: 我不常上岸，东西就沉了
lines.en: I rarely surface; things sink.
This thing tastes of the sea.
I tuck it between scales.
Too much has sunk to the floor.
It's not big; I'll carry it.
The water muddied as I picked it up.
I'll put it back; I don't want it.
Something has entered the temple.

lines.zh: 水流里有一道不对的痕
lines.en: There's a wrong line in the current.
I raise my head toward it.
Smell of iron, and lamp oil.

lines.zh: 我不急，水会把它推过来
lines.en: No rush; the water will push it to me.
Just one target.

lines.zh: 它没有退路了，下面是深沟
lines.en: No retreat; below is a deep trench.
I know these waters better than you.
Locked; swimming to it.
It looked up and saw me.
It wants to rise; I won't allow it.
I press down from above it.
It's slower than me in water.
It grabs the pillar; the pillar shakes.
Two blocks closer and I ram.
Its feet slide in the silt.
It's retreating to the temple door.
I've guarded that door for centuries.
It rose half a block.
Above is the surface; no escape there.
I ram and the water bursts apart.
My tail sweeps and flips it over.
My crystals shudder and flash.
I bite its leg and drag it deeper.
My body presses down and it can't move.
This one carries prismarine's hardness.
It blocked once, hands shaking.
I turn and come again, loud in the water.
I slam it into the temple pillar.
It's sinking; I follow.
The temple's water rippled once.

lines.zh: 我从海沟的暗处升上来
lines.en: I rise from the dark of the trench.

lines.zh: 鳞上的光先到，身子后到
lines.en: The light on my scales arrives before my body.

lines.zh: 这片海又有人闯进来了
lines.en: Someone has broken into this sea again.

lines.zh: 我浮在柱子上方，看着下面
lines.en: I hover above the pillars, watching below.
This life was given by the temple.
My crystals light one by one.
I swim out of the crevice.
Still so long my fins have stiffened.
The door stands, so I stand.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧不起来，只是冒汽
lines.en: Fire won't burn here, it only makes steam.

lines.zh: 我落下来，压起一圈泥沙
lines.en: I fell and raised a ring of silt.
Water is mine; I can't drown.

lines.zh: 水下爆炸闷响，我退了远
lines.en: The underwater blast boomed dully and I was pushed far.

lines.zh: 箭在水里慢下来，被鳞挡住
lines.en: The arrow slowed in water and my scales stopped it.
The spell scattered in the current.
Hungry or not, I keep this watch.

lines.zh: 雷击穿水面，我整条身子一颤
lines.en: Lightning pierced the surface and my whole body spasmed.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我呼吸不了
lines.en: No water in the void; I can't breathe.
